title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park on 1969-07-12
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park
source: Partial SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985; Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > R > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard remaster with clear audio but some out‑of‑tune moments; China Cat Sunflower shines.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard source that many reviewers find well‑remastered and generally clear, though one listener notes the band being out of tune in places. China Cat Sunflower receives particular praise as a highlight of this performance. Overall the show is enjoyable but not flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gives a strong 4‑star endorsement of the remaster while another rates it 0 stars with unrelated criticism; the positive comments focus on good sound quality and a standout song, balanced by noted tuning issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered soundboard tape is generally clear and well‑balanced; no major dropouts reported, though a reviewer mentions the band sounding out of tune, which may be performance‑related rather than technical.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall solid set with a strong highlight in China Cat Sunflower, but occasional sections feel out of tune, affecting the flow for some listeners.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer notes the band (likely guitar) sounding out of tune.
